spec.name: Halloween Midnight Eel
spec.description: A small midnight-purple eel curled into an open hook, with amber eyes, scattered mint markings and tiny fins. Fourteen connected, axis-aligned cuboids preserve the transparent space inside its curl. Static, original Halloween item for Orange SMP.

prompt: Small curved midnight-purple eel with little mint spots and amber eyes, connected static blocky form. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
